items.claim: Gillian Robertson does not finish fights often and has only one stoppage win in her recent fights.
items.quote: she's got one stoppage win in her last, you know, couple fights here. Just doesn't finish that often.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern is tough to take out with only one knockout loss and has never been submitted.
items.quote: Mackenzie Dern tough to take out, like I said, one knockout loss, never been submitted.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern's striking is better than Gillian Robertson's.
items.quote: I think her striking is better than Gillian Robertson's.

items.claim: Mackenzie Dern will be more active with the wrestling and grappling in the fight against Gillian Robertson.
items.quote: I think Dern will be more active with the wrestling and grappling.

items.claim: Ian Garry will be the biggest opponent that Islam Makhachev has fought.
items.quote: Ian Garry will be the biggest opponent that Islam's fought
